recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic lavender room featuring a surreal arrangement of mid-century modern furniture, a taxidermy fox on a glass table, and a vintage television displaying a face, all captured in a flat, high-key studio lighting style.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic lavender environment unifying disparate objects
Contrast between organic taxidermy and geometric wire furniture
The television screen as a focal point of 'life' within a static room
Deep perspective created by the corner of the room and furniture placement
coreInvariants: Uniform lavender hue across walls and floor
High-angle perspective looking down into the room corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Objects are distributed across the lower two-thirds of the frame in a sparse, staged manner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vintage television set on the right-side desk acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the fox on the left, follows the floor lamp upward, and settles on the television and top-right typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive lavender negative space in the upper half and center floor creates a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (Furniture frames, Picture frame, Lamp base)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value pastel base with high-contrast black graphic lines.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast between thicks and thins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist and title, distinguished by a slight space.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the era.
Provides the necessary elegance and vertical stress.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle shot of a room corner where the floor and walls are all painted the same shade of lavender. On the left, a taxidermy fox stands on a glass coffee table with black wire legs. In the center, a tall black floor lamp with a white shade. On the right, a black wire desk with a vintage 1970s television on top showing a grainy face. A black wire chair sits in front of the desk. A framed picture of a black panther hangs on the left wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the text in the top right corner using a high-contrast serif italic font in black. The text should be small and elegant, justified to the right margin.

verificationChecks: Is the furniture primarily black wire-frame?
Is the text in the top right corner in a serif italic?
Does the television show a face?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact face on the television screen
Original artwork inside the wall frame

mustAchieve: Precise monochromatic color matching between floor and wall

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lavender color is consistent across the floor and walls.
Check that the wire furniture has thin, clean black lines.
Verify the typography is a high-contrast serif in the top right corner.
Confirm the taxidermy animal looks realistic but static.
Ensure the television is a vintage CRT model.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Room + Wire-frame Furniture + Displaced Object (Taxidermy) + High-Contrast Serif Typography = 80s Surrealist Minimalism
